title: Standalone VIXEN configure needs a manual Undertow schema catalogue path
body: On the vixpin base 204c22d6, the standalone VIXEN worktree is not adjacent to Undertow's core, so the relative probes in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt cannot find schemas.json. The successful fresh configure needed -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json to keep AppFlow/ViewNounId and all 22 codegen guards enabled. Consolidate discovery from the workspace/register so isolated VIXEN worktrees do not need a manually supplied cross-repository path.

title: VIXEN codegen does not locate the kernel repo in isolated project worktrees
body: The vixpin configure had to pass -DYEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy so the pinned snapshot and CodegenTool checks ran. VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt only probes /home/liory/Github/Yeroket-Fantasy (or the WSL home equivalent), while the granted kernel checkout is under /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy. Consolidate kernel-repo discovery through the workspace manifest or a stable environment setting, and report the selected root.

title: VIXEN kernel snapshot cache needs a manual worktree-local path for isolated lanes
body: To keep generated snapshot and CodegenTool cache files inside the authorized worktree, the fresh configure needed -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vixpin/build/kernel-cache; the default resolves to /home/liory/.cache/vixen/kernel-codegen outside the lane. Add a lane/worktree-aware default or environment override so isolation does not require a per-run CMake property.
